metadata.description: Agent skills for NeuroAPI - Neurobro's public API for financial market research

plugins.name: neurobro-market-research
plugins.description: Run financial market research through the NeuroAPI agent - equities (US, Indonesia, Brazil, Vietnam), crypto, commodities, and macro via POST /agent/ask

plugins.name: neurobro-meme-hunting
plugins.description: Discover and risk-vet trending and newly launched memecoins through the NeuroAPI agent - screen tokens for scam flags, mint and freeze authority, holder concentration, and buy/sell pressure, and filter new launches by age and liquidity

plugins.name: neurobro-trading-setup
plugins.description: Build structured trade setups for crypto, stocks, and commodities through the NeuroAPI agent - entry zones, stop-loss, take-profit targets, and risk/reward ratios

plugins.name: neurobro-catalyst-watch
plugins.description: Build event-driven trade plans through the NeuroAPI agent - map upcoming catalysts (earnings, FOMC and macro prints, token unlocks, mainnet launches, listings, ETF and regulatory decisions), assess what is priced in, and plan positioning before and after the event
